summary.text: An Nsukka-area LGA on the border with Benue and Kogi, made up of two towns: Enugu-Ezike, the headquarters, which is Igbo, and Ette, which is ruled by an Igala king and is mostly Igala and Idoma, with little Igbo settlement.

peoples.name: Igbo
peoples.note: The people of Enugu-Ezike. Igbo settlement in Ette is small.

peoples.name: Igala
peoples.note: With the Idoma, the majority in Ette, one of the LGA’s two towns. Ette’s king, the Onu-Oda, is Igala and holds his staff from the Attah at Idah.

peoples.name: Idoma
peoples.note: With the Igala, the majority in Ette. Egenti (2015) finds Idoma the language Ette people use most.

languageUse.text: Ette speaks Igala, Idoma and Igbo; Egenti (2015) finds Idoma used most. Enugu-Ezike speaks Igbo.
